''See also: [[Remnants Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Remnants are non-physical constructions of [[pure madra]] that manifest when a powerful [[sacred artist]] or [[sacred beast]] dies. They appear as vivid, colorful outlines or sketches of their former physical forms—such as trees, animals, or humans—often lacking fine detail like texture or leaves. While they possess the ability to reason, speak, and negotiate, their intelligence is limited by a narrow scope of fragmented memories from their previous lives. Their behavior can range from aimless drifting and disorientation to extreme aggression or even total devotion to a new master. These entities function by consuming [[madra]] to sustain themselves and increase their power, though they naturally dissipate back into essence as they expend their energy. The strength and complexity of a [[Remnant]] often correlate to the power of the individual it originated from; for instance, those from [[Heralds]] appear more lifelike and retain stronger wills. Because they are made of concentrated [[madra]], [[Soulsmiths]] can harvest their remains to create various constructs. While some parts are used for structural skeletons, the most precious components are the [[binding|bindings]] found within them. These harvested materials can be used to create both functional tools, like drudges or weapons, and "dead constructs" that possess only the inherent properties of the [[madra]] used to make them.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As humans and animals advance in power, they leave behind entities known as Remnants. These creatures are composed entirely of [[madra]] and appear as bright emerald sketches or outlines rather than accurate depictions of their former selves. When utilized to pull carriages like oxen, they resemble fine glass or heat haze and produce sounds akin to whips and thunder during movement. These beings can also carry aspects of light and exhibit an attraction toward [[Samara's ring|Samara’s ring]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Remnants]] are made of bright emerald color and appear as mere sketches or outlines rather than accurate depictions of what they were in life.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c7">''Unsouled'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Remnants]] are made entirely of [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c7" />}}</li>

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Remnants are creatures that possess greater intelligence and strength than the spirits found in [[Sacred Valley]], sometimes appearing with an acidic green hue. These entities function as parasites or [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] that attach themselves to hosts, and they are known to climb up from corpses. While some Remnants have the ability to fly, others may behave aimlessly by sitting or counting clouds rather than attacking.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] are stronger and smarter than spirits from [[Sacred Valley]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4">''Soulsmith'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] can be acidic green in appearance.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] are described as parasites or [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] attached to hosts.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8">''Soulsmith'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] are creatures that can attack or simply behave aimlessly like sitting or counting clouds.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11">''Soulsmith'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Remnants]] climb up from corpses.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Some [[Remnants]] can fly.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" />}}</li>

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|In a stone room, crimson lion Remnants that were once [[Truegold]] remain sealed to defend the space. Within the [[Akura fortress]], fifteen-foot-tall guards resembling dried lizard corpses serve as Remnants. These entities were cultivated by the [[Akura clan]] from beings left by [[Lords]] on the same [[Path]] to reach power levels matching [[Heralds]]. Carrying halberds that blaze with a unique black-and-violet dragon's fire, these Remnants possess the ability to pull [[sacred artists]] through the sky.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Crimson lions in a stone room are [[Remnants]] sealed to the defense of the room.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The crimson lion [[Remnants]] were once [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The guards of the [[Akura fortress]] are [[Remnants]] that are fifteen feet tall and look like dried lizard-corpses.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c14">''Skysworn'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The [[Remnants]] carry halberds that blaze with black-and-violet flame, which is a different breed of dragon's fire than [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The [[Remnants]] were left by [[Lords]] on the same [[Path]] and cultivated by the [[Akura clan]] to match [[Heralds]] in power.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Remnants]] can pull [[sacred artists]] through the sky.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18">''Skysworn'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
